picks.title: SwitchHDR, an AI model for HDR reconstruction from SDR video
picks.excerpt: Beeble unveiled SwitchHDR, an AI model that reconstructs HDR imagery from standard SDR footage, outputting scene-linear 16-bit EXR sequences for professional VFX and post pipelines. 'Where real detail survives we recover it; where it's fully clipped, the artist decides how it gets rebuilt,' says CEO Hoon Kim.
picks.rationale: New AI model turning SDR footage into scene-linear 16-bit EXR HDR for VFX/post — directly changes how a colorist or comp artist works tomorrow, from a credible outlet.

picks.title: NVIDIA 'Neural Rendering, World Models and Simulation' Keynote Set for SIGGRAPH 2026
picks.excerpt: NVIDIA Research leaders Neil Ashton, Ming-Yu Liu and Edward Liu will deliver a SIGGRAPH 2026 keynote on advances in neural rendering, world models and AI-driven simulation, signaling where generative graphics for film and VFX are headed.
picks.rationale: Agenda-setting keynote signaling where neural rendering and world models take film/VFX next — credible and forward-looking for artists tracking the pipeline shift.

picks.title: Lightcraft Launches Beta for Spark Story Interactive Previz Tool
picks.excerpt: Lightcraft opened a rolling beta of Spark Story, an interactive previz tool that lets filmmakers block scenes, populate asset libraries and render full-quality 'superdailies' in real time — working with AI or blue/greenscreen keyers to compress previsualization and cut early production costs.
picks.rationale: Interactive previz tool now in open beta — real-time superdailies and scene blocking filmmakers can sign up for today to compress previz and cut early production cost.

picks.title: Adobe adds experimental AI Playground to Project Indigo camera app
picks.excerpt: Adobe added an experimental AI Playground to its Project Indigo computational-photography app, letting shooters apply generative editing directly after capture — pushing on-device generative image manipulation well beyond simple style transfer.
picks.rationale: Fresh Adobe release putting on-device generative editing right after capture — a hands-on new capability shooters can try today, from a reputable outlet.
